searchText: Small fix in EOF spec: ```diff - - During `CALLF`, the following must hold: `stack_height + types[code_section_index].max_stack_height <= 1024` + - During `CALLF`, the following must hold: `stack_height + types[code_section_index].max_stack_height - types[code_section_index].inputs <= 1024` ``` ```diff - - During `JUMPF`, the following must hold: `stack_height + types[code_section_index].max_stack_height <= 1024` + - During `JUMPF`, the following must hold: `stack_height + types[code_section_index].max_stack_height - types[code_section_index].inputs <= 1024` ``` (and the same for runtime overflow check) Both current stack_height and callee's max_stack_height include inputs, so we were double-counting them.

excerpts.content:
Small fix in EOF spec:
```diff
- - During `CALLF`, the following must hold: `stack_height + types[code_section_index].max_stack_height <= 1024`
+ - During `CALLF`, the following must hold: `stack_height + types[code_section_index].max_stack_height - types[code_section_index].inputs <= 1024`
```
```diff
- - During `JUMPF`, the following must hold: `stack_height + types[code_section_index].max_stack_height <= 1024`
+ - During `JUMPF`, the following must hold: `stack_height + types[code_section_index].max_stack_height - types[code_section_index].inputs <= 1024`
```
(and the same for runtime overflow check)

excerpts.author: gumb00
excerpts.content: Both current stack_height and  callee's max_stack_height include inputs, so we were double-counting them.
